key.livingrealms.open_creative_catalog: Open Living Realms Creative Mod Catalog
tooltip.livingrealms.legitimacy: Legitimacy: how accepted the current ruler and government are.
tooltip.livingrealms.influence: Influence: how much power you can exercise with an institution, separate from reputation.
tooltip.livingrealms.war_exhaustion: War exhaustion: cumulative strain from fighting that weakens morale and peace willingness.
tooltip.livingrealms.route_security: Route security: how safe a trade road is from bandits and war.
tooltip.livingrealms.settlement_pressure: Settlement pressure: the strongest local shortage or threat driving contracts and unrest.
tooltip.livingrealms.sovereign_debt: Sovereign debt: money a realm owes; unpaid service can lead to default and legitimacy loss.
tooltip.livingrealms.social_mobility: Social mobility: citizens can rise or fall through education, skill, wealth and opportunity.
message.livingrealms.onboarding.first_se: You have reached a Living Realms settlement. Roads, markets and citizens are projections of a living simulation.
message.livingrealms.onboarding.map: Press M to open the strategic world map.
message.livingrealms.onboarding.dashboar: Press F12 to open the realm dashboard for government, economy and contracts.
message.livingrealms.onboarding.npc: Talk to citizens for local knowledge. Help requests come from real shortages.
message.livingrealms.onboarding.catalog: Press K for the creative item catalog when in creative mode.
